ENGAGEMENT LETTER

Dear Client,

We are pleased to confirm our engagement to represent you in connection with [Matter Description].

1. SCOPE OF REPRESENTATION
Our representation is limited to the matter described above.

2. FEES AND BILLING
Our fees will be billed at our standard hourly rates, currently ranging from $350 to $650 per hour depending on the attorney assigned. Flat-fee arrangements, where offered, will be set forth in a separate written addendum. A retainer of $5,000 is due upon execution of this letter. This retainer is non-refundable.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY
All communications between you and the firm, whether in person, by telephone, by email, by text message, or through any cloud-based or digital platform, are protected by the attorney-client privilege.

4. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this engagement upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

Sincerely,
[Attorney Name]

appliedChanges.description: Added digital communications to confidentiality clause
